task: Ingest db.irowiki.org (iRO Wiki Database) monster/item stat data into a local searchable corpus under run/knowledge/iro-db/

source.attribution: Data (c) Gravity Co., Ltd. and the iRO Wiki (irowiki.org / db.irowiki.org) contributors. Ingested read-only for local research use; no redistribution or republishing. Ragnarok Online is (c) Gravity Co., Ltd.
source.robots_txt: robots.txt at db.irowiki.org returned empty (no Disallow rules) at ingest time

url_patterns_discovered.etc_coverage: no item search section covers Etc-type items; those ids were harvested from monster drop tables (item-info links on fetched monster pages) plus the /db/arrow-craft/ listing
url_patterns_discovered.card_listing_note: card-search states "2220 items" but those are entries including duplicate variant rows (685 ids have >1 row, e.g. id 4662 x13); unique card item ids = 1009. Completeness cross-checked: 569 distinct card ids are referenced by monster drops, 568 of which are in the card listing; the missing one (4179 Dragon Fly Card) was harvested via drops and ingested.
url_patterns_discovered.json_api: none found; all pages are server-rendered HTML (search is GET-param driven, parsed from stable CSS-classed tables)

politeness.user_agent: ro-bots-knowledge-ingest/0.1 (local research corpus; polite sequential crawler)

requests.note: one earlier aborted run made ~9 requests before a crawler-detection bug (false-positive Cloudflare check) was fixed; ingest is resumable and the aborted run stored no records

schema.monsters_jsonl: {id, section:"monsters", name, url, fetched_at, fields:{level, hp, def, mdef, attack, range, aspd, move_speed, base_exp, job_exp, hit, flee, size, race, element, mode, stats{agi,vit,int,dex,luk}, elemental_damage{}, drops:[{id,name,rate}]}, raw_html}
schema.items_jsonl: {id, section:"items", name, url, fetched_at, sections:[gear|weapon|card|consume|costume], fields:{type, subtype, weight, element, weapon_level, required_level, upgradable, damagable, atk, def, buying_price, selling_price, slots, description, extra{}, dropped_by[{id,name,rate}]}, raw_html}
schema.sqlite: iro-db.db: entities(section,id,name,url,fetched_at,sections,fields_json,raw_html) + fts_pages(title,body,section UNINDEXED,ref_id UNINDEXED,url UNINDEXED) + meta(k,v)
